title: Page 4
content_zh:
「天雨在闹脾气。」天睛靠进他怀里，抓着他的指头把玩。
「闹什么脾气？」那家伙不是只会笑得一脸呆，哪会发脾气？
「她说你叫我晴天，应该叫她雨天才公平。」
这种事也有公平不公平？「你看她那个样子，哪里像雨天？叫她艳阳天还差不多！」
「对啊，天雨很呕，她说好名字被我抢走，她只能用坏名字，害她三不五时掉眼泪。」
「流眼泪好啊，才不会得乾眼症。」
天睛笑笑。 「她真的很介意自己没有外号呢，你勉强叫她雨天吧。」
勉强自己可不是他蒋誉会做的事。
「要外号？可以啊，我叫她跳跳，她从早跳到晚，跳个不停……对啊，她为什么不跟你一起学芭蕾？」
「天雨也喜欢跳舞，但受不了芭蕾舞刻板固定的动作。」
「爱新鲜的黄毛丫头。」
他看向远处的跳跳，她把平衡木当成竹竿舞，从左边跳到右边、右边又跳回左边。
「昨天她跑来问我，『姊，为什么阿誉爱你？』」
他笑。「你怎么说？」
「我说，我和阿誉的心绑在一起啊。她又问：『要怎样，才可以把阿誉的心和我绑在一起？』」说完，天晴横他一眼，要不是天雨年纪小，她肯定要大吃醋。
「没办法，我太有女人缘。」他得意的咧。
「她很喜欢你。」
「我也喜欢她啊，不然，你看我几时带我们家那只阿烲出门？」在他眼里，没长大的小人都是以「只」做为计数单位。
「要不，下次你把阿焚带出来，有人陪天雨，她才不会无聊。」
「不行，我怕触犯儿童保护法。阿烲国二就破除童子之身，和他混，我担心青出于蓝，还是让她孤独一点，在平衡木上面跳来跳去比较安全。」

天睛听完咯咯笑不停，然后又勾住他的手臂问：「阿誉，你的梦想是什么？」
「你的梦想又是什么？」
「我要好好练舞，以后开一间舞蹈教室。」她爱死了舞蹈教室里时不时传出来的铃鼓声，和穿着粉红色篷篷裙的小天使。
「我的梦想是赚大钱。」他说。
「为什么？你很缺钱吗？」
「我要赚很多钱给你开一间舞蹈教室。阿誉的梦想就定完成晴天的梦想。一他的脸还是臭，但嘴里飘出来的话，香得很迷人。
还有什么情话比这句更浪漫？天睛笑出甜甜的枫糖浆。
凝睇她的笑颜，他确定再确定，他们的未来一定要相挂勾。
这时天雨从远处跑来，手里抓着一把鬼针草花。「送给阿誉。」
女孩子送花给他？很有趣的经验，他的脸很臭，但心在笑。
他收下花，叮咛一句，「叫阿誉哥哥。」做人要懂得尊敬长辈。
「不要，叫阿誉。」
「你叫阿誉哥哥，我才叫你跳跳。」
「跳跳？」
「你不是想要外号吗？跳跳，像知更鸟在树梢跳来跳去，像在夜市里买的小跳鼠，东跳西跳。」
「跳跳、跳跳、跳跳……」她重复在嘴里发出同样的音节，然后拉开嘴角笑开。「我喜欢跳跳，比雨天好听。」
「对，你不是雨天，你是最舒服、乾爽的二十六度艳阳天。」他被爱情训练了，训练出满口甜言蜜语，而且大小通吃。
从那天以后，他开始叫她跳跳，除了他和晴天以外，没有人叫她跳跳，因为跳跳是他取的，是他和晴天的共同下午、共同回忆。
记忆，全是酸的，因为晴天消失了。
失去晴天，只独留雨天，哪个人能在霪雨霏霏的世界里不忧郁？

蒋誉抽回手，发现跳跳又流口水了。
坏习惯，每次睡觉都流口水，他还以为这种习惯等长大就会好了，没想到她一路流到二十二岁。
二十二岁……真快，当年的婴儿肥女生已经亭亭玉立，变成国际知名舞星。
她不爱芭蕾，怎又去学芭蕾？真想代替晴天完成未完成的愿望？
记得离开台湾前一晚，她冒雨跑到他家门口，郑重说：「阿誉要等跳跳哦，总有一天，跳跳会回来，替你把心底的大洞补起来。」
大洞补得起来吗？他不知道，只知道自己已经习惯冷风浇灌，习惯低温心脏，十度保鲜。
下床、进客厅，他掩上房门，拿手机拨号。
「杜绢，是我。」他压低音量。
「是，总经理。」她的声音中规中矩，不像昨晚刚接受求婚的幸福小女人，看来她对婚姻的盼望真的不太高。
这样很好，他对婚姻也没有过度期望。婚姻嘛，不就是两个人生活在一起，互相陪伴，共同完成繁殖计划？再好的状况就是两个人一起变老，生病时相互打气，儿女不孝时，有个共同的对象可以唠叨。
「今天我不进公司。」
自他正式成为公司一员，从没请过假，假期对他而言并没有太大意义，与其在家里自伤，他宁愿让自己忙得不得了。
「……是。」杜绢的语气里有一丝讶异，但除此之外，也没有多余的话。
「有急需签定的文件，送过来给我。」
他一面讲手机，一面走到门口架前，翻翻片子，下意识地翻出莫札特的小步舞曲，手指头轻轻划过，这首曲子，他已经很久没听。
「知道。」杜绢说。
「还有其他事吗？」
「晚上郭董的生日会，总经理要参加吗？」她的原子笔指在郭董生日会那行，
等他下决定。
「你去找我二哥，问他可不可以代替我去。」应酬这种事，偶尔也该落在二哥身上，他逃避太久了。

「知道。」
「有搞不定的事再联络我。」
「是，总经理再见。」她的口气非常公式化。
结束通话，他回房间洗澡换衣服后，拿起车钥匙，离开屋子。
跳跳起床后，整个房子里外绕一圈，都没看见阿誉，他大概上班去了吧。
她进浴室，彻头彻尾洗去一身风尘，换上黄色洋装。
她不爱穿洋装的，喜欢穿洋装的是姊姊，但为了妈妈，她开始学习穿洋装、扮小公主，努力把「雨天」升级成「晴天」。
进到客厅，湿湿的披肩长发把衣服弄湿了，她也不在意，只是坐进沙发，盘起双脚，愣愣地看着眼前的落地窗。
阿誉，始终没有忘记姊姊，这样一片落地玻璃窗，是最好的证明。
她咬着下唇，苦苦地笑了。
走到CD架前面，她一眼就看见那片被抽出来的莫札特小步舞曲。是这首曲子……二度证明，阿誉没忘记过晴天。
这么想、这么爱啊……她该感激感动、她该为阿誉做点事。
第2章(2)
跳跳把桌子、沙发搬开，挪出一个大空间，再跑进房间，从行李箱里翻出舞鞋、舞衣，换好装、系上鞋带，把小步舞曲放进音响里。
站在客厅中间，压下遥控器，她娇俏可爱的身影像橱窗里面的娃娃。
一二三四，轻轻拉高手臂、抬起下巴，对着落地窗，露出可爱笑脸。
当当当，壁钟敲过十二响，工作一天的老板沉睡了，橱窗里的娃娃眨眨双眼，伸伸懒腰，醒来了。
停八拍。
过往的情景在跳跳胸口发酵，阳光投射进来，在她的刘海抹出一道金黄灿烂。
五六七八，开始！

脚跟蹬起，几个快速的小跳脚，旋转、跳跃，她随着音乐在客厅里面飞舞。
这是阿誉为姊姊买下的舞台，她要为姊姊和阿誉尽情飞舞……
三步奔跑，一个劈腿腾空跳跃，返身，再一次半空跳跃，然后，立定、踮脚尖，用力旋转，一圈、两圈、三圈，她在美丽的晴天里享受阳光照耀。
content_en:
"Tian Yu is having a temper." Tian Jing leaned into his arms, grabbed his fingers and played with them.
"Why are you so angry?" That guy just smiles blankly, how can he lose his temper?
"She said that if you call me Sunny, it would be fair to call her Rainy."
Is this kind of thing fair or unfair? "Look at her look, how does it look like a rainy day? It's better to call her a sunny day!"
"Yes, Tianyu is disgusting. I took away her good name, so she could only use a bad name, which made her cry all the time."
"It's good to shed tears so you don't get dry eye syndrome."
Tian Jing smiled. "She really doesn't mind that she doesn't have a nickname. You can just call her Yutian."
Forcing himself is not something Jiang Yu would do.
"You want a nickname? Okay, I told her to dance, and she danced from morning to night, non-stop... That's right, why doesn't she learn ballet with you?"
"Tianyu also likes to dance, but can't stand the rigid and fixed movements of ballet."
"A yellow-haired girl who loves freshness."
He looked at the dancing in the distance. She used the balance beam as a bamboo pole dance, jumping from left to right, right and back to the left.
"Yesterday she came to me and asked, 'Sister, why does Ayu love you?'"
He laughs. "What did you say?"
"I said, Ayu's and I's hearts are tied together. She asked again: 'How can I tie Ayu's heart to mine?'" After saying that, Tianqing glanced at him. If Tianyu hadn't been young, she would have been very jealous.
"I can't help it, I'm too popular with women." He grinned proudly.
"She likes you very much."
"I like her too, otherwise, when will I take our little one out?" In his eyes, the little people who have not grown up are counted in "only".
"How about, next time you take Ah Fen out, Tian Yu will have someone to accompany her, so she won't be bored."
"No, I'm afraid of violating the child protection law. A-Xi Guo Er is going to break away from her child's body and hang out with him. I'm worried that she will outperform her, so it's safer to leave her alone and jump around on the balance beam."
Tianqing couldn't stop giggling after hearing this, and then hooked his arm and asked, "Ayu, what is your dream?"
"What is your dream?"
"I want to practice dancing well and open a dance studio in the future." She loved the sound of tambourines that came from the dance studio from time to time, and the little angel wearing a pink poncho.
"My dream is to make a lot of money," he said.
"Why? Are you short of money?"
"I want to make a lot of money to open a dance studio for you. Ayu's dream is to fulfill Qingtian's dream. His face still smells bad, but the words coming out of his mouth smell very charming.
What love words are more romantic than this one? Tian Jing smiles sweet maple syrup.
Gazing at her smile, he was sure and sure that their future must be linked to each other.
At this time Tianyu came running from a distance, holding a handful of ghost needle grass flowers in his hand. "To Ayu."
The girl gave him flowers? It was a very interesting experience, his face was stinky but his heart was smiling.
He accepted the flowers and warned, "Call Ayu brother." A person must know how to respect his elders.
"No, call me Ayu."
"You call me Brother Ayu, and I call you Tiaotiao."
"Jumping?"
"Don't you want a nickname? Jumping, jumping around like a robin on the treetops, like a little jerboa bought at the night market, jumping here and there."
"Jump, jump, jump..." She repeated the same syllable in her mouth, then opened her mouth and smiled. "I like dancing, it sounds better than rainy days."
"Yes, you are not a rainy day, you are the most comfortable and dry 26-degree sunny day." He was trained by love, and he was trained to speak sweet words, and he accepted them all.
From that day on, he began to call her Tiaotiao. No one called her Tiaotiao except him and Qingtian, because Tiaotiao was his name. It was the afternoon and memory he and Qingtian shared together.
Memories are all sour because the sunny day disappeared.
Losing the sunny sky, only being aloneSave for rainy days, who can not be melancholy in this world of rain and falling rain?
Jiang Yu withdrew his hand and found that Tiao Tiao was drooling again.
She had a bad habit of drooling every time she slept. He thought this habit would get better when she grew up, but he didn't expect her to drool until she was twenty-two years old.
Twenty-two years old... it's so fast. The fat girl back then has become a slim girl and has become an internationally famous dancing star.
If she doesn't love ballet, why should she learn ballet? Do you really want to fulfill your unfinished wish on Sunny Day’s behalf?
I remember that the night before leaving Taiwan, she ran to his door in the rain and said solemnly: "Ayu, I have to wait for Tiao Tiao. One day, Tiao Tiao will come back and mend the big hole in your heart."
Can the big hole be repaired? He didn't know, he only knew that he was used to being watered by cold winds, used to having his heart kept at a low temperature, and kept fresh at ten degrees.
After getting out of bed and entering the living room, he closed the door and dialed a number on his cell phone.
"Du Juan, it's me." He lowered his voice.
"Yes, general manager." Her voice was regular, unlike the happy young woman who just accepted the proposal last night. It seemed that her expectations for marriage were not very high.
This is good, and he doesn't have excessive expectations for marriage. Marriage, isn't it just two people living together, accompanying each other, and completing the reproduction plan together? No matter how good the situation is, two people grow old together, cheer each other up when they are sick, and have a common person to nag when their children are unfilial.
"I won't enter the company today."
Since he officially became a member of the company, he has never asked for leave. Holidays do not mean much to him. Instead of hurting himself at home, he would rather keep himself busy.
"...Yes." There was a hint of surprise in Du Juan's tone, but other than that, there was no unnecessary words.
"If you have documents that need to be signed urgently, please bring them to me."
While talking on his cell phone, he walked to the door shelf, flipped through the movies, and subconsciously pulled out Mozart's Minuet, running his fingers lightly over it. He had not listened to this piece of music for a long time.
"I know." Du Juan said.
"Is there anything else?"
"Does the general manager want to attend Director Guo's birthday party tonight?" Her ball pen pointed at the row of Director Guo's birthday party,
Wait for him to make a decision.
"You go to my second brother and ask him if he can go instead of me." Things like entertainment should occasionally fall on the second brother. He has avoided it for too long.
"I know."
"If you have any questions, please contact me."
"Yes, goodbye general manager." Her tone was very formulaic.
After ending the call, he went back to his room to take a shower and change clothes, then picked up his car keys and left the house.
After jumping out of bed, I walked around the whole house and didn't see Ayu. He must have gone to work.
She went into the bathroom, washed away all the dust and put on a yellow dress.
She doesn't like to wear dresses, but her sister likes to wear dresses. But for her mother, she started to learn to wear dresses, pretend to be a little princess, and strive to upgrade "rainy days" to "sunny days".
Entering the living room, her wet shawl hair made her clothes wet. She didn't care. She just sat on the sofa, crossed her legs, and stared blankly at the floor-to-ceiling windows in front of her.
Ayu has never forgotten his sister. This floor-to-ceiling glass window is the best proof.
She bit her lower lip and smiled bitterly.
Walking to the CD rack, she immediately saw the piece of Mozart Minuet that had been pulled out. This song... proved for the second time that Ayu had never forgotten the sunny days.
She thinks so, loves so much... She should be grateful, she should do something for Ayu.
Chapter 2(2)
Tiaotiao moved the table and sofa away to create a large space, then ran into the room, took out her dance shoes and dance clothes from the suitcase, changed her clothes, tied her shoelaces, and put the minuet music into the stereo.
Standing in the middle of the living room, pressing the remote control, her cute and cute figure looked like a doll in the window.
One, two, three, four, gently raise your arms, lift your chin, and face the floor-to-ceiling window with a cute smile.
Dang, dang, dang, the wall clock struck twelve, the boss who had been working all day fell asleep, and in the windowThe doll blinked, stretched, and woke up.
Stop for eight beats.
The past scenes were fermenting in her chest, and the sunlight came in, creating a golden streak on her bangs.
Five six seven eight, start!
Kicking up her heels, doing a few quick little jumps, spinning and jumping, she was flying around the living room to the music.
This is the stage Ayu bought for her sister. She wants to dance to her heart's content for her sister and Ayu...
She ran in three steps, jumped in the air with a split leg, turned around, jumped in mid-air again, then stood still, stood on tiptoes, and spun hard, one, two, three times, enjoying the sunshine on the beautiful sunny day.
